title: add_terraform_module
description: Adds a new Terraform module block to the appropriate Terraform configuration file.

module_name.description: The local name used for the module block in Terraform configuration (e.g. 'vpc', 'rds_cluster').

source.description: The module source address, which can be a Terraform Registry path, a Git URL, or a local path (e.g. 'terraform-aws-modules/vpc/aws', 'git::https://example.com/modules/vpc').

version.description: The version constraint for the module (e.g. '3.14.0', '~> 4.0', '>= 2.0, < 3.0').

inputs.description: An optional map of input variable names to their values to pass into the module block.
